candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool exhaustion inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout correlation failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable after ~2s; order returns 503, gateway client sees ReadTimeout on /v1/orders and returns 502 on /v1/checkout. Logs and metrics corroborate 502s and ~2s latency on /v1/checkout. Redis and payment calls succeed, so pool exhaustion at the order->postgres dependency is the bounded candidate.
